1444979199001956356.a: Despite the stuff I had I would have been dead long ago without people who cared to keep me alive. People are all that matter. People have made everything you see around you. Even your so called nature was likely planted and groomed by people. True nature I fear has been extinct.

1444980742556200966.a: The tumor was removed Sep 21. Neuro says I may be the fastest healing patient they had. Neuro expected I would be in patient for 10-14 days. I could have gone home in 3 days but they kept me in ICU until the MRI confirmed. I went home in 5 days. Proper diet, vitamins make people.

1444982223766175744.a: The hardest sell I have with everyone I know: You are not eating enough food. You are not eating food your body needs. Every body is different. You need a blood panel then to adjust diet. I know this intimately. Humans should not get fatigued. This is a disease born of lies.

1444982225049690116.a: You hear people talking of "standard range" on blood panels and other body chemistry. i.e. Bottom of standard range on sodium. Electrolytes need to be, over long time periods, dead center. Each day you eat more or less or sweat... Riding the extremes is like a piano out of tune.

1444983143350652930.a: Second thing I hear is "I don't need vitamins!" Bull****. And here is why: Climate change. We evolved our dietary needs 200k years ago. 50kya climate change jacked up the chemistry of our food. Now we are doing it at warp speed. Most need a prenatal vitamin + high dose B complex.

1444983998862794752.a: This is a really hard thing to wrap your head around: Mankind functionally went extinct ~13kya-50kya.
